answer: Because each walnut escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the canyon ledger records every share and the tide audit shows the split. Assembling that for 144 aliases means 144 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
